# awx_notification_template_mattermost (Resource)

Manages an AWX `Mattermost` (`mattermost`) notification template with first-class typed configuration attributes. Equivalent to `awx_notification_template` with `notification_type = "mattermost"`, but with per-field schema validation and sensitivity instead of a JSON `notification_configuration` string.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mattermost_no_verify_ssl` (Boolean) Verify SSL.
- `mattermost_url` (String) Target URL.
- `name` (String) Name of this notification template.
- `organization` (Number) Organization this notification template belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of this notification template.
- `messages` (String) Optional custom messages for this notification template, as a JSON object.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Database ID of this notification template.
- `notification_type` (String) AWX notification type, fixed by this resource.
